commanders: Maj. Gen. Joseph Hooker (US) assaulting the Confederate left held by elements of Bragg's Army of Tennessee

cwsac.note: CWSAC has no standalone Lookout Mountain entry; it is part of the Chattanooga battle.

abt_facts.verbatim: 'the Battle of Lookout Mountain occurred on November 24, 1863' … 'By 2:00 pm, the "Battle Among the Clouds" was over.'

60th_ny_role.source: NY State Military Museum 60th Infantry historical sketch (Phisterer)
60th_ny_role.verbatim: 'at Lookout Mountain, 37 were killed and wounded (the Sixtieth capturing one cannon and battle flag).'
60th_ny_role.brigade_corps: 3rd Brigade, 2nd Division, 12th Corps (Geary's division, Hooker's command)
60th_ny_role.hubbell_note: Sergeant A. F. Hubbell (Co. H) is named among the 60th's wounded in Richard Eddy's 1864 regimental history casualty list for this assault.
